# StudySmarter

> > StudySmarter is a digital learning platform in Europe offering B2B solutions for employer branding, student recruiting, and product placement to connect companies with next-generation talent.

StudySmarter for Business provides companies like Accenture with targeted access to students and young professionals through its learning app ecosystem. The platform specializes in campus recruiting, employer branding campaigns, and B2B marketing solutions tailored for reaching engaged learners across Europe.

## Key Topics

- StudySmarter
- Employer Branding
- Student Recruiting
- Campus Recruiting
- Next-Gen Talent
- Product Placement
- Learning Platform
- B2B Marketing
- Accenture
- Europe

## Business Solutions

- [StudySmarter for Business: Employer Branding, Recruiting and Product Placement](https://business.studysmarter.co.uk/): B2B platform for employer branding & recruiting via StudySmarter learning app
